<h1 class="about-hello">Welcome!</h1>
<hr class="about-divider">
<p>Hi! I'm Vikesh, a fourth-year Hydrologic Science and Policy (B.S.) student at UC Santa Barbara. My professional interests span hydrologic modeling, water quality, climate change adaptation, remote sensing, machine learning, GIS, groundwater, and regulatory compliance. I hope my work will improve the lives of people and the health of our environment.</p>
